name: setManagedBotAccessSettings
description: Use this method to change the access settings of a managed bot. Returns _True_ on success.

parameters.name: user_id
parameters.description: User identifier of the managed bot whose access settings will be changed

parameters.name: is_access_restricted
parameters.description: Pass _True_ if only selected users can access the bot. The bot's owner can always access it.

parameters.name: added_user_ids
parameters.description: A JSON-serialized list of up to 10 identifiers of users who will have access to the bot in addition to its owner. Ignored if _is\_access\_restricted_ is _False_.
